newsitem.title: CANADA: Broadcast Centre Trust sets C$400 million bond.
newsitem.headline: Broadcast Centre Trust sets C$400 million bond.

text.p: Canada's Broadcast Centre Trust on Thursday set a C$400 million non-fixed price bond due May 1, 2027 in financial markets.
The bond was set to yield 7.53 percent, 23 basis points over the 8.0 percent Government of Canada bond due June 1, 2023.

Proceeds of the issue would be used to repay the trust's debt, which was incurred in the construction of the Canadian Broadcasting Corp's Broadcasting Centre. The CBC is owned by the Canadian government.
The new issue is secured by a Canadian Broadcasting Corp and Government of Canada lease obligation.

Scotia Capital Markets and Lehman Brothers Canada Inc are joint lead managers of the issue. Other members of the syndicate include CIBC Wood Gundy Securities, Nesbitt Burns Inc, RBC Dominion Securities Inc and TD Securities Inc.
